title: Hotel Check-In Conversation
description: A relaxed, conversational podcast-style video that walks listeners through a typical hotel check-in dialogue, highlighting key phrases and cultural nuances for travelers.
thumbnailPrompt: A cozy hotel lobby with warm lighting, a friendly receptionist greeting a guest, soft pastel background, cinematic look

scenes.title: Welcome to the Lobby
scenes.imagePrompt: Hotel lobby interior, warm orange lighting, receptionist desk with a smile

audio.text: Hey everyone! Today we’re stepping into a hotel lobby. Let’s hear what the receptionist says when you walk in.

scenes.title: Greeting and ID
scenes.imagePrompt: Receptionist asking for ID, guest handing over passport

audio.text: "Good afternoon! Can I see your ID, please?" says the receptionist. Remember to keep a friendly tone.

scenes.title: Reservation Details
scenes.imagePrompt: Receptionist typing on keyboard, guest nodding

audio.text: The receptionist checks your reservation. "I see you’re booked under Smith for a double room." Make sure to confirm the dates and room type.

scenes.title: Room Key & Amenities
scenes.imagePrompt: Receptionist handing a keycard, showing amenities list

audio.text: "Here’s your keycard. Breakfast is at 7 AM in the lounge, and we have free Wi‑Fi. Anything else I can help you with?"

scenes.title: Ask About Check-Out Time
scenes.imagePrompt: Guest asking about check-out time, receptionist smiling

audio.text: If you need a late check‑out, just ask. "What’s the check‑out time?" The staff will let you know if they can accommodate.

scenes.title: Final Goodbyes
scenes.imagePrompt: Receptionist waving goodbye, guest walking away into lobby

audio.text: All set! The receptionist says, "Enjoy your stay and let us know if you need anything. Have a great day!" And that’s it—check‑in complete.
